definitions.gloss: crocodile tears, fake tears, false tears
definitions.explanation: Tears that are not genuine but shed for show, to manipulate others or feign emotion. The prefix {空|そら} means "fake" or "pretended."

examples.japanese: ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空涙|そらなみだ}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空涙|そらなみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}して→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦{同情|どうじょう}→同情：11954_doujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}こう→引く：01978_hiku⟧とした。
examples.english: She shed fake tears trying to get sympathy.

examples.japanese: {空涙|そらなみだ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{泣|な}かれる→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断|ことわ}れない→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: Even knowing they are fake tears, I can't refuse when someone cries.

notes:
USAGE:
The ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧~ prefix means "fake" or "pretended" and appears in other words like {空返事|そらへんじ} (half-hearted reply) and {空惚|そらとぼ}ける (to play dumb). {空涙|そらなみだ} implies deliberate deception.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空涙|そらなみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to shed fake tears)
- {空涙|そらなみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use fake tears)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嘘泣|うそな}き→嘘泣き：08463_usonaki⟧: fake crying — similar meaning, more colloquial
- {空涙|そらなみだ}: fake tears — slightly more literary
